doc.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023

title: Brothers who are also drummers and artists
summary: Three brothers are professional drummers or in music; another is an artist and musicologist who can name personnel on any record.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And am I correct that your brothers then copied you?

Well I think we all copied my father, at least three out of the five, three other brothers, Tony, Eric and Nicholas are all professional drummers or involved in the music business in some way. And one brother is purely an artist, although he’s a great musicologist so I often ask him who’s playing on this record? “It was Toots and the Maytals from 1963” and he’ll tell me the whole personnel and the studio they recorded in. He’s very knowledgeable about music, but doesn’t actually play drums.
It seems like you grew up in an incredibly creative atmosphere.
